title: Single hieratic sign, Kairo, Institut français d’archéologie orientale, P. IFAO H 3 (AKU HT 50125)

object.name: Kairo, Institut français d’archéologie orientale, P. IFAO H 3

source.attribution: Facsimile by Maren Goecke-Bauer; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 50125

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 50125; AKU grapheme G0240 (AKU GR 259). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: G7 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 188, 188 (v4p3), 188B. Occurrence: line 2; find place Deir el-Medina; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 16.2 x 5.2 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 20. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (Kooperationspartner), by Maren Goecke-Bauer. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
